style: Precision counter-striker & range-control kickboxer in a matte charcoal-obsidian and slate-navy MMA compression rashguard, open-finger black leather MMA gloves with woven wrist wraps, compression fight tights, and leather shin guards
claims: Rigged to the standard Mixamo mixamorig: 65-bone skeleton normalized to meter scale (Armature scale=[1,1,1] with inverseBindMatrices and all 28 animation clips converted to meters so Three.js Skeleton.prototype.pose() renders at full 1.73m scale)

Removes the 6 floating sci-fi spacesuit armor/gadget pods (2 left-forearm computer pods and 4 floating shoulder armor pods) and 3 duplicate opaque eyelash cards from Mesh 0 Prim 0, and smooths the upper back hump and spacesuit collar ring into an athletic crew-neck collar and upper torso

Resculpts the 3D facial bone structure of Prim 1 Comp 0 (chin projection +5.2mm, mandibular jaw width +14%, zygomatic cheekbones +2.2mm, lowered supraorbital brow ridge -2.2mm, vertical eye aperture refined -12%, lip protrusion refined -1.6mm) and tucks the outer eyelash card corners inward

Splits Mesh 0 Prim 1 into 3 dedicated PBR primitives (Ch48_skin, Ch48_eyes, Ch48_upper_gear) with all emissiveTexture maps removed, mirror-wet corneal tear film (clearcoatFactor 1.0, roughness 0.031, IOR 1.38) isolated exclusively to Ch48_eyes, and non-clearcoat human skin (IOR 1.40, sheen, dermatological pore normal & roughness maps) on Ch48_skin

Reconstructs 4096x4096 Diffuse maps and 2048x2048 Normal, MetallicRoughness, and Specular maps: removes all winged eyeliner across all channels, centers photorealistic hazel-chestnut irises at straight-ahead binocular gaze (U=0.9478, V=0.3125 and U=0.8676, V=0.3125) with pink lacrimal caruncles, and replaces goth lipstick with natural rose-terracotta vermilion lips

Completely removes the yellow chest emblem, white sci-fi circuit lines, purple harness straps, and hexagonal honeycomb normals across all texture maps, replacing them with a matte charcoal-navy compression rashguard, open-finger black leather MMA gloves with bare human skin fingers and crimson-charcoal cotton wrist wraps, compression fight tights, and black leather shin guards

Includes a custom combat sound effects suite in sfx/ combining 11 curated CC0 Kenney OGG impacts/whooshes with 8 studio-mastered multi-layered 44.1 kHz WAV strike and K.O. bell audio files, plus all four 1920x1080 Three.js beauty renders (front, three_quarter, profile, closeup)
